answer: The dawn index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the whisper queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 811 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ember. A 166 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
